topic: Template Function with Type Traits and Iterator Distance Calculation
explanation: This concept demonstrates how to define a generic template function in C++ that computes the distance between two iterators of any type. It leverages template parameters, type traits (specifically 'iterator_traits'), and the 'typename' keyword to deduce and specify the return type based on the iterator's properties. This approach enables writing highly reusable and type-safe code that adapts to different iterator types in the Standard Template Library (STL).
